entry.name: url
entry.label: Folder to show. Empty means the Downloads folder.

entry.name: fanLimit
entry.label: How many files the fan shows before falling back to "N more".

entry.name: fanIconSize
entry.label: Icon size in the fan, in pixels.

entry.name: newestAtTop
entry.label: Put the first file of the sort order (newest, by default) at the top of the fan and the "more" entry at the bottom.

entry.name: fanLean
entry.label: How far the top of the fan leans sideways, in degrees from vertical. The fan always starts vertical at the panel icon.

entry.name: direction
entry.label: Which way the fan curves: 0 = automatic, 1 = right, 2 = left.

entry.name: previews
entry.label: Show thumbnails instead of file type icons where available.

entry.name: sortMode
entry.label: Sort column: 0 = name, 1 = size, 2 = date, 6 = type.

entry.name: animationDuration
entry.label: Fan animation length in milliseconds, before the global animation speed is applied.
